title: Elodie and the Cover
author: Juniper Eriksen
blurb: Bram Whitlock, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
